caption:
🚆 One day of trains in Germany — 24 hours, every service.

43,124 scheduled services across 7,540 stations. Look for the centre and you won't find one: unlike France or Britain, Germany has no single capital pulling everything, so traffic spreads across Berlin, Hamburg, the Ruhr, Frankfurt and Munich at once 🇩🇪 Watch the ICE lines thread through a dense regional mesh.

📊 Data: Deutsche Bahn / DELFI timetables via gtfs.de (CC BY 4.0), Thursday 3 September 2026. Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
